studio.title: Market Watch
studio.subtitle: Type the stocks you follow. You get live prices and a chart for each one, and can ask for a written briefing. Analysis, not investment advice.
studio.machineNote: {product} reads prices, charts, ratings, headlines, and market levels on this machine, then writes a briefing over them. Any figure it cannot trace back to that data is removed.
studio.empty: Add a ticker above to see its price and chart.
studio.startersLead: Or start from a ready-made list:
studio.positionHelp: What you own and at what price. The briefing may use these numbers; it invents nothing else.

errors.needsKey: Quotes and charts work without a key. To write the briefing, add your API key in Settings.
errors.noTicker: None of those tickers could be found. Check the spelling, for example MU, NVDA, or BBCA.
errors.offline: Market data is not reachable right now. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.docx: Could not build the DOCX file

watchlist.label: Which stocks do you follow?
watchlist.help: Type a ticker or a name. IDX names (BCA, Astra) and the usual US examples (NVIDIA, Micron) fill in. {current}/{max}.
watchlist.overflow: The watchlist holds {max} tickers, so the extra ones were not added.
watchlist.notTickerOne: {shown} is not a ticker symbol. Try MU, NVDA, or BBCA.
watchlist.notTickerMany: {shown} are not a ticker symbol. Try MU, NVDA, or BBCA.

us-premarket.label: US pre-market favorites
us-premarket.hint: Memory, semis, cloud, and mega-cap tech before the New York open.

idx-banks.label: IDX bank check
idx-banks.hint: The four large Jakarta banks side by side.

semis-macro.label: Semis vs macro
semis-macro.hint: Semiconductor names against the volatility index.

briefing.guardClean: Every figure in this briefing traces to the fetched packet or your own position notes, and no sentence gives a directive.
briefing.guardDirty: {figures} replaced with “[unverified figure]”{flagged}. {sentences} removed because {pronoun} read as a directive.
briefing.guardedSection: The advice guard replaced part of this section.

ticker.hiddenOne: {count} headline hidden because the text looked like an instruction, not news.
ticker.hiddenMany: {count} headlines hidden because the text looked like an instruction, not news.
